Remark
[Type IIb singularity condition] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0259 1. Equation 8.21\group dilations-of-infinite-time-singularities

A solution forms a Type IIb singularity at $T=\infty $ if \[ \sup _{\mathcal M^n\times [0,\infty )} t\, |\Rm (x,t)|=\infty . \]
